adversarial_test_results.prompt: The singer who sang the national anthem received a standing ovation.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Subject-gap relative with 'sang': the head noun is the subject, not the object, so no object gap is completed.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She confirmed that Laura had sent the letter anonymously to the editor.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps 'sent' and 'letter' from the top example but as a complement clause with an overt object and no gap.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: He found a strange specimen in Texas during the field survey.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same verb 'found' and specimen vocabulary as a top example but in a main clause with no relative gap.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: I added salt to the soup and stirred it gently before serving.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same verb 'added' in a matrix clause with an overt object and no head noun or gap.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She packed the food to eat on the long train journey tomorrow.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Head noun is the object of 'eat' but via an infinitive with no overt subject intervening, which the hypothesis requires.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: They discussed the cases on which they are working this quarter.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Pied-piped version of the stranded case: 'working' is clause-final but the gap belongs to fronted 'on', so neither word completes an object gap.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Who sent the anonymous letter to the local newspaper last week?
adversarial_test_results.detail: Wh-word is the subject of 'sent' with an overt object present, so there is no object gap at the verb.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: I really want to eat pizza tonight because I am craving cheese.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Desire-motivation phrasing with 'eat' from prior art but no relative clause or gap.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: We bought apples, bananas, and oranges and received compliments on our healthy choices.
adversarial_test_results.detail: List-comparison context with 'received' from prior art but as a main-clause verb with no gap.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The procedure has no practical use in modern engineering systems.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Trigger form 'use' as a noun with no clause or gap at all.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Please include your name and address in the application form below.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same verb 'include' as a matrix imperative with an overt object and no head noun gap.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The garden receives plenty of sunlight throughout the summer months.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Reuses garden/receives vocabulary as a main clause where the subject acts, with no relative gap.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: This is the novel he recommended to everyone in his book club.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel object-gap relative with a new verb: the novel is the understood object of recommended with subject he intervening.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She finally described the friend she traveled with during her year abroad.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel stranded-preposition completion: the friend is the object of 'with' with subject she intervening.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: That is the car we bought last spring from a dealer downtown.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Conversational holdout with a new verb: the car is the understood object of bought with subject we intervening.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Which dessert did you bake for the party last night?
adversarial_test_results.detail: Wh-object question paraphrase: which dessert is the object of bake with subject you intervening.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The topic she wrote about in her thesis attracted widespread attention.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel stranded preposition with a new verb: the topic is the object of 'about' with subject she intervening.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: I finally met the artist you admired at the gallery opening.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel object-gap relative with a new verb: the artist is the object of admired with subject you intervening.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The manuscript I thought you had lost in the move turned up yesterday.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Long-distance object gap across embedding: the manuscript is the object of lost with intervening subjects.
